[SERVICE DOMAIN: Card Clearing] BIAN Service Landscape V14.0 - vista MATRIX
UBICACION Business Area : Operations and Execution Business Domain : Cross Product Operations Anidado : Payments (capacidad de negocio agrupadora, no un nivel del metamodelo)
BUSINESS DEFINITION (proposito) This service domain orchestrates the capture and consolidation of card financial trans actions originating from various sources. It also handles the clearing of the transact ions from the Acquirers to the Issuers through the Card Networks
METAMODELO Control Record = Asset Type + Generic Artifact Functional Pattern : Process Asset Type : Card Clearing Generic Artifact : Procedure Control Record : Card Clearing Procedure
ESTRUCTURA DEL CONTROL RECORD (Card Clearing Procedure Instance Record, 8 atributos) Network Reference | Participant Acquirer Bank Reference | Participant Acquirer Bank Clearing and Settlement Terms | Participant Issuer Bank Reference | Participant Issuer Bank Clearing and Settlement Terms | Card Clearing Process Type | Card Clearing Process Date and Time | Card Clearing Service Schedule
BEHAVIOR QUALIFIERS (7) Capture (16 atributos) Addressing (1 atributos) FX Conversion (2 atributos) Charge (2 atributos) Matching (1 atributos) Reconciliation (1 atributos) Routing (1 atributos)
